corrected.title: The Russian Guard's plotted approach takes one side of a divided register without saying so; nobody holds Blasowitz when it falls 'from the Russian Guard'; the plan text contradicts the role text
corrected.observed: The register is divided: the disposition (C6.21, A, an order) and Stutterheim (C6.c6, A, labelled disputed) put the Guard on the Blasowitz-Krug heights with its jägers in Blasowitz; the official Allied report printed in 1806 (C1.3/C6.22, B, fact) puts it on 'the ordered height of Krzenowitz', attacked from Pratzen. The map's geography follows the report (dawn by Krzenowitz, graded A; rg_inf@5's carried A at 10:30 3.0 km from Blasowitz; the fight between Pratzen and Krzenowitz), its Blasowitz event follows Stutterheim (no Allied formation within 1.43 km at 11:15, the Guard 1.54-1.78 km away and never nearer than 1.5 km all day), and its plan tab and plan theme ('behind Krzenowitz', unchecked) contradict its own role text ('behind Blasowitz and Kruh', attributed to the disposition). The 04:00 A anchors precede the disposition's daybreak and match Stutterheim's starting point, so they contradict no reading; the A grades are questionable because the 07:00-11:00 place is disputed and no note says which side the map takes.
corrected.category: confirmed-defect (the internal contradictions); the Guard's place 07:00-11:00 unresolved-historical
